newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Dean Ramos said Thursday he cut his rating on electronics retailer Best Buy Co Inc to a hold from a buy.
-- He also cut his third quarter earnings estimate to $0.16 a share from $0.47. A year ago, it earned $0.41. The fourth quarter view was trimmed to $0.52 from $0.65, compared with $0.46 last year.
-- Also reduced was the fiscal 1997 estimate to $0.77 a share from $1.22, which compares with $1.10 a year ago. The fiscal 1998 estimate was cut to $1.24 a share from $1.50.
-- Earlier, Best Buy reported a drop in October same store sales of 15 percent, which was well Dain's expectations, the analyst said.
-- Best Buy also said its third quarter earnings would be significantly below last year's $0.41 a share.

-- "While we believe the company's gross margin has continued to improve, the lack of sales leverage resulting from a weakening overall consumer electronics environment and slowing consumer personal computer sales will likely cause negative expense leverage for the coming quarters," Ramos said in a report.
-- Best Buy shares were off 3-3/4 at 12-1/2.
